payload.name: Preserve explicit adjectives in memory extraction
payload.description: When extracting a memory from a statement in which the speaker explicitly describes a subject with a specific adjective, keep that exact descriptor in the candidate memory content.
content: During extraction or update, if the source directly describes a subject with an explicit adjective or qualifier, include that exact adjective in the memory content. Do not replace precise evaluative words with broader paraphrases or implications. Only include descriptors that are explicitly supported by the source; do not infer unstated ones.

solves: When a source explicitly applies an adjective to a subject, extraction can drop that specific descriptor while keeping a broader implication, so later factual questions miss the exact claim. Preserve explicitly stated evaluative adjectives in the memory content rather than replacing them with paraphrase. This applies to any future extraction where a speaker directly characterizes something; it does not require inferring descriptors not stated.
